text_id: Minggu ini 37 sel gambut di Riau berisiko tinggi mengering. 2 sekat kanal rusak atau jebol. Ada 4 kasus terbuka dan 1 kasus diteruskan ke pemadam kebakaran.
text_en: This week 37 peat cells in Riau are at high risk of drying. 2 canal dams are damaged or broken. There are 4 open cases and 1 case was sent to the fire brigade.
